result.topic_en: Estimates for how close products of powers of certain algebraic units times θ = ∛2 (resp. ⁵√2, ⁷√2) come to integers, with the error expressed via the conjugates of the units, for θ = ⁵√2 and θ = ⁷√2.
result.transcription:
$l, m, n$ are \underline{any} integers including $0$ (84)
$\theta = \sqrt[5]{2}$.   Add Ms a 94$^{18}$ (84)
$a = \frac{1}{\sqrt[5]{2}-1}$, $b = \frac{\sqrt{5}}{(1+\sqrt[5]{4})^{\frac{5}{2}}}$
$a^m b^n \theta = p_{m,n} + \varepsilon_{m,n}$
where $-\frac{1}{2} < \varepsilon_{m,n} < \frac{1}{2}$ and $p_{m,n}$ is an integer. Then
$\varepsilon_{m,n} = O\,\frac{5^{\frac{n}{2}}}{\left(\sqrt[5]{4} - 2\sqrt[5]{2}\cos\frac{2\pi s}{5}+1\right)^{\frac{m}{2}}\left(\sqrt[5]{16}+2\sqrt[5]{4}\cos\frac{4\pi s}{5}+1\right)^{\frac{5n}{4}}}$
where $s$ is the most unfavourable of the integers
$1, 2, 3, 4$.
$\theta = \sqrt[7]{2}$
$a = \frac{1}{\sqrt[7]{2}-1}$, $b = \frac{7}{(\sqrt[7]{8}-1)^7}$, $c = \frac{\sqrt[7]{2}+1}{\sqrt[7]{4}-\sqrt[7]{2}+1}$,
$a^l b^m c^n \theta = p_{l,m,n} + \varepsilon_{l,m,n}$
$\varepsilon_{l,m,n} = O\,\frac{7^m\left(\sqrt[7]{4}+2\sqrt[7]{2}\cos\frac{2\pi s}{5}+1\right)^{2n}}{\left(\sqrt[7]{4}-2\sqrt[7]{2}\cos\frac{2\pi s}{7}+1\right)^{\frac{l}{2}}\left(\sqrt[7]{64}-2\sqrt[7]{8}\cos\frac{6\pi s}{7}+1\right)^{\frac{7m}{2}}\left(\sqrt[7]{64}+2\sqrt[7]{8}\cos\frac{6\pi s}{7}+1\right)^{\frac{n}{2}}}$,
where $s$ is the most unfavourable of the integers
$1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6$.
